text:
[LCRS.8.2] The engine suppresses a `call` carrying `cooldown: <dur>` when the
same call site has issued the call within `<dur>` for the same key: the values of
the declared `key` slots of each `logical` fact the activation binds, as
rule-level cooldown is keyed ([LCDB.3.3.1]). A `ttl` or event fact contributes
no slot ([LCDB.3.3.3]) and a `call` takes no `by:` ([LCRS.8.1]), so where the
activation binds no `logical` fact with a `key` slot the key is empty, and the
call site has one window across all its activations. An author who needs
a window per entity over such a fact writes a rule-level `cooldown` with `by:`
([LCDB.3.3.4]). Each call site has its own window,
so two calls in one rule cool independently, and a suppressed call does not stop
the rule's other actions. `nocooldown` issues the call every time the rule fires;
the adapter's own argument-dedup LRU still fires as a safety net.

---

idris.name: Lcrs_6_2_1__site
idris.note: The site's gate: the window and the activation key as a function of the fired match. LESS than the clause: the key is the lowering's composition -- the `logical` facts' key slots, the empty key and one window per site where the activation binds none with a `key` slot, as the clause has it -- and the model proves nothing of how it is composed.

idris.name: Rlow_4_6_6_1__trackers
idris.note: Each call site has its own window: its own tracker, keyed (rule, site, key); one window across the activations of a site whose key is empty, as the clause has it. LESS than the clause: the key is the lowering's composition.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__admitted_call_supersedes
idris.note: AN ISSUED CALL SUPERSEDES: past its window the call retracts the live reply of its correlation before it is issued; the shape executed on working memory where the vector reads a `log` probe. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__cooldown_suppressed_retracts_nothing
idris.note: A SUPPRESSED CALL RETRACTS NOTHING: inside the window the rule fires, the site is refused, no call is recorded and the reply stays; the shape executed on working memory where the vector reads a `log` probe. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__site_cooled
idris.note: The witnesses' cooled site, keyed on the trigger's identity key, [LCDB.3.3.1]'s rule-level default. LESS than the clause: the trigger is an entity and not a `logical` fact, so the clause's key for this site is empty and its window one across the site's activations; the fixture keys per trigger, the key being a function of the match the model takes as given and proves nothing of. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__suppressed_retracts_nothing
idris.note: A CALL ITS COOLDOWN SUPPRESSES IS NOT ISSUED AND RETRACTS NOTHING: inside the window the accumulator is left exactly as it was. The gate covers the sweep as it covers the call.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__call_site_inv
idris.note: A call site keeps the invariant: admitted, its issue is a correlation sweep; refused, the net stands.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__admit_gate
idris.note: The site's gate: `nocooldown` admits with the trackers untouched; a window decides at the clock on the key of the fired match under (rule, site).

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__allow
idris.note: The per-call rate-allow: Rete/RateGate.idr's gate over the site's key at the instant, recording `key -> now` on allow.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__allow_admits
idris.note: The gate's `true` applied: the site's key is stamped with the instant.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__allow_refuses
idris.note: The gate's `false` applied: nothing moves.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__call_site
idris.note: A call site run: the gate at the net's clock on the site's tracker, then the issue under the verdict; the gate covers the sweep as it covers the call.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__first_call_admitted
idris.note: A SITE WITH NO RECORDED ISSUE IS ADMITTED and stamped, over every window, instant and table.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__refires_at_the_boundary_call
idris.note: AT OR PAST THE BOUNDARY THE SITE ISSUES AGAIN and is restamped, the boundary itself included.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__site_admitted
idris.note: AN ADMITTED SITE SWEEPS, RECORDS AND STAMPS: the issue on its net, the stamps kept, the trackers the gate's, the call recorded after the ones before.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__site_decided
idris.note: A site decided: the trackers take the gate's, then the issue under its verdict.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__site_refires_at_the_boundary
idris.note: The site's boundary is inclusive: suppressed at 5, issued at exactly 10, the reply then swept. Computed.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__site_refused
idris.note: A REFUSED SITE LEAVES THE NET, THE STAMPS AND THE RECORDS: only the trackers are the gate's.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__window_suppresses_call
idris.note: THE WINDOW SUPPRESSES THE CALL: a site's key stamped inside the window is refused and the trackers do not move.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_6_6__no_gate_admits
idris.note: `nocooldown` is no gate: admitted every time, the trackers untouched. A transcription, said so.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__do_actions_called
idris.note: The RHS with calls: at each position the sites there, then the action there; the sites past the last action after it.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__run_sites
idris.note: The sites of one position run in order, each on the accumulator the last left: two calls in one rule cool independently, a suppressed one stops nothing else.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__Attempt
tla.note: The rule firing with the call in its RHS: the gate admits it (Fire) or suppresses it (Deny). What the two cooldown properties quantify over.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__DENIALS
tla.note: How many times a cooled call may be suppressed in a run, at most; 1 in every config. A bound on the state and nothing in the clause.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__Deny
tla.note: The gate suppresses a cooled call whose window has not elapsed: not issued, retracts nothing, only the count of denials moves. The ungated teeth engine, with the sweep compiled ahead of the gate, has it retract what an admitted firing would.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__WINDOW
tla.note: The cooldown window in ticks, one for every cooled call; 1 in every config, the smallest window a tick can elapse. The clause's `<dur>`, counted in the model's ticks.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__admits
tla.note: The gate: a call with no cooldown, or one whose window has elapsed, is admitted. The nogate teeth engine admits every firing. Transcribes the clause's 'issued within <dur>' as 'fewer than WINDOW ticks since the last admitted firing'; the key, the stamp and the clock the gate reads are formal/k/rgate.k's and Rete/RateGate.idr's, not this model's.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__denied
tla.note: Per cooled call, how many times the gate has suppressed it.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__since
tla.note: Per cooled call, the ticks since its last admitted firing, saturating at the window and starting there, since a call that has never fired is admitted.

tla.name: lcrs_8_2__suppressed_not_issued
tla.note: A cooled call's firing inside its window issues no request: the adapter is owed nothing new. Bounded: two calls, the one with an author's `as` cooled with a one-tick window, one denial per run; the nogate teeth engine violates it, and the readmitted probe shows the window elapse and the call fire again.

tla.name: rarc_5_2_4__Tick
tla.note: The tick is what elapses a cooled call's window: the gate reads the pump's monotonic sample, which moves with the clock the TTL reads.
